$comment: T-5.03: first-run hints, in the order they are offered. Each shows once a device, the first time its `when` holds (and every hint named in `after` is behind it), for up to `showSeconds`; it is done — never shown again — once the player does `doneBy`, dismisses it, or it has been shown. Done before it ever shows (a player who already knows) counts too. Hints are `gapSeconds` apart. Conditions: start, enemy-seen, magazine-low, squad (squadmates who take orders, `squadAfterSeconds` in), mate-downed, under-fire, near-gun. Actions: move, fire, reload, order, mark, throw, revive, crouch, mount.

hints.text: W A S D to move · Shift to sprint · Space to vault a low wall
Left mouse fires · hold right mouse to aim down the sights
C crouches behind cover · Z goes prone
R reloads — the magazine is low
Hold Q for the order wheel — move, attack, hold, regroup, revive — and release to give it
F marks the enemy under your crosshair for the whole squad
G throws a grenade · 5 readies it to aim the arc
A squadmate is down — hold E beside them to get them up
